blocks.what_we_do: Install the R packages used by the course. A package is an add-on that gives R more functions. Keep the project from step 0.4 open.
blocks.why: The course needs `archive`, `digest`, `getPass`, `knitr` and `rmarkdown`. Installing them now prepares the masked password prompt and the data checks.
blocks.you_need: A working project from step 0.4 and an internet connection.
blocks.command:
```{r s0-5_packages, eval=FALSE}
source("R/package_setup.R")
install_course_packages()
source("R/course.R")
```

The first run can take several minutes. Wait until the `>` prompt returns. Run this installation command yourself; the whole-path script omits it.
blocks.expected_result: The `>` prompt returns. If packages were installed, R also prints `Course packages are ready.` Already installed packages need no download.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check your internet connection. On Linux, the helper chooses matching ready-made Posit packages where they exist. If source installation is needed, it explains which development libraries you need. Ask the instructor or your institution's support team for help.
blocks.quick_check:
Do these R packages replace the PLINK executable?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>No. Put PLINK 2 in `bin/` at step 0.6.</details>
blocks.files_created: R package files in your R library. No course data are created.
